summary.text: Meegan Zickus is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 89, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and professor, she says she is a bioethics professor and former two-term school board member from Allendale.

paragraphs.text: Zickus earned a high school diploma from Wyoming Park High School, an associate degree from Grand Rapids Community College in 1992, a bachelor's degree from Grand Valley State University in 1995, and a law degree from the Michigan State University College of Law in 1999.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney and professor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother, wife, grandmother, attorney, bioethics professor, author and small-business owner who has lived in Allendale for more than 25 years and served two terms on a school board.

Zickus summarized her campaign in the survey as care, costs and class: affordable health care including mental-health services and support for family caregivers, lower everyday costs for working families, and strong public schools.
